thread.title: The Dow Rises 76 Points as Markets Await Apple Earnings

title: The Dow Rises 76 Points as Markets Await Apple Earnings
text:
The Dow Rises 76 Points Because Corporate Earnings Are Only So-So By Jan. 29, 2019 12:17 p.m. ET Order Reprints Illustration by Michael Haddad Text size
Stocks were heading in opposite directions midday Tuesday after a mixed bag of earnings reports. Investors are more concerned about what comes after the close: Apple (ticker: AAPL) earnings on Tuesday, followed by the end of the Federal Reserve’s two-day meeting Wednesday. With little movement on U.S.-China trade, investors have scant distraction from a so-so slate of earnings and from what criminal charges against the major China telecom player Huawei Technologies will mean.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was 0.3% higher at recent check, while the S&P 500 was off 0.2% and the Nasdaq Composite was down 0.7%.
Midday Movers
GameStop (GME) dived 27.5% to $11.24 after saying it is not for sale .
Harley-Davidson (HOG) slid 7.2% to $33.99 after reporting fourth-quarter earnings . The motorcycle maker earned 17 cents a share on revenue of $955.63 million, while analysts were looking for EPS of 30 cents on revenue of $1.05 billion.
Nvidia (NVDA) fell 2.9% to $134.04 after being downgraded to Equal-Weight from Overweight at Morgan Stanley and to Underweight from Buy at Needham. It was also removed from Bank of America Merrill Lynch’s US 1 List on the heels of its downbeat fourth-quarter outlook.
Pfizer (PFE) edged 1.9% higher to $40.29 after reporting an upbeat fourth quarter that offset light 2019 guidance.
PulteGroup (PHM) slipped 2.8% to $29.26 after reporting fourth-quarter earnings . The home builder earned $1.11 a share on revenue of $3 billion, while analysts were looking for EPS of $1.10 on revenue of $2.9 billion. However, a decline in orders amid affordability issues spooked investors.
